headlines.title: Sandisk (SNDK) Stock Looks Below Fair Value After Its 179% Run
headlines.summary: Sandisk has shifted from a sharp multi month rally to a steep pullback, and investors are now asking whether the current share price is still supported by what the business is earning. Over the past year the stock has returned 179.3%, which puts significant focus on whether its earnings can support that kind of move.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang back as Nvidia CEO after 12 days: Shares surge 30%
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down the stunning news of the morning: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstating founder Jensen Huang as CEO just 12 days after his resignation. Including his five takeaways on what the reversal says about corporate governance, the role Washington played in the decision, and the rally that's lifting the whole AI trade while sending AMD lower. Brian is joined by New Street Research technology infrastructure analyst Antoine Chkaiban on the new checks around Huang and why he's still a buyer; "In the Loop" host Ejaz on key-man risk and whether the "Bank of Nvidia" reopens for neoclouds; EMJ Capital founder and president Eric Jackson, who calls the return a win for open-source AI; Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman on the board's credibility and Colette Kress's future; Moor Insights & Strategy founder and chief analyst Patrick Moorhead on the politics behind the ouster and why nothing changes for AMD for 18 months; and SlateStone Wealth partner and chief market strategist Kenny Polcari on whether this kicks off a year-end rally.

description: Sandisk Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells data storage devices and solutions using NAND flash technology in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and internationally. The company provides solid state drives for desktop and notebook PCs, gaming consoles, and set top boxes; and flash-based embedded storage products for mobile phones, tablets, notebook PCs and other portable and wearable devices, automotive applications, Internet of Things, industrial, and connected home applications, as well as removable cards, universal serial bus drives, and wafers and components. It sells its products to computer manufacturers and original equipment manufacturers, datacenters, private cloud customers, cloud service providers, resellers, distributors, and retailers through its sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. Sandisk Corporation was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Milpitas, California.
